recognize_zh: 移植後患者上顎黏膜瀰漫性紅斑並散布許多小白點／小丘疹（A），以及硬顎上白色網狀角化斑塊與紅斑交錯（B），是口腔慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）的苔蘚樣（lichenoid）變化。
features: Panel A: diffuse erythema of hard and soft palate with numerous small pale punctate papules
Panel B: confluent white hyperkeratotic lichenoid plaques on the hard palate interspersed with erythema
White keratotic change extending along the maxillary gingiva/vestibule in panel B
No discrete deep ulcer or mass lesion visible
describe_en: Clinical photographs of the palate in patients with chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows diffuse erythema of the hard and soft palate studded with numerous small pale papules; small translucent papules on the soft palate in this setting can represent superficial mucoceles from minor salivary gland involvement. Panel B shows confluent white hyperkeratotic, lichenoid plaques admixed with erythematous mucosa over the hard palate and adjacent gingiva. No mass lesion or deep ulceration is evident. Findings are consistent with oral mucosal cGVHD with lichenoid features.

ddx.vs: Candidal plaques wipe off to leave a raw base and show yeasts/pseudohyphae on KOH or PAS, whereas lichenoid cGVHD keratosis is fixed.
Clinically and histologically similar lichenoid interface change, separated mainly by the transplant history and associated multi-organ cGVHD manifestations.
Smoker's palate shows keratotic white mucosa with central red dots at minor salivary duct orifices, lacking the erythematous lichenoid plaques and transplant context.
